I stopped and called rest, but I'm not fully sure the robot is directly in front of the panel.

The green panel is close and fills most of the view ahead and to the right. The panel seems to be on a wall at an angle to the robot, not squarely facing it. The side sonars read 0.76 m on both sides, so the robot is in a narrow passage near the panel. It is now in a crouch with motors off.
